session.label: SESSION PREVIEW
session.title: Clear before you hit the water

session.heading: Comfortable sets
session.warmContent: 400 m freestyle — progressive build over the last 100 meters.
session.mainContent: 5 × 300 m freestyle at endurance pace — 30 s rest. Steady breathing, glide after each push-off.
session.coolContent: 300 m easy mixed — backstroke and breaststroke to loosen the shoulders.
session.tip: Coach tip: conversational pace. If you can't talk anymore, you're going too fast — lengthen the rest.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: I've never followed a structured plan — is it for me?
faq.a1: Yes if you already know how to swim. Beginner level uses simple volumes and clear language. MySWYM structures your sessions — it's not a learn-to-swim school.
faq.q2: Can I change my goal along the way?
faq.a2: Yes. From your profile, you can restart onboarding for a new goal and regenerate a plan. With Premium, you can also manage several plans in parallel.
faq.a3: The first {{weeks}} weeks are free. Then a Stripe subscription unlocks the rest of the plan through your event (monthly or annual). Secure payment; monthly has no lock-in.
faq.a4: Yes for monthly: cancel from your customer portal and keep access until the end of the paid period. Annual is prepaid — clearly shown at checkout.
